scenario: [LUNI.8.8]: the operands of `min` stand beside each other as the operands of `+` do, so a bare number beside a dimensioned value is refused. `min(s.d, 3)`, with `d` a `meter`, is DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.luni_8_8_min_max_type`, from `lexp_5_3_plain_call`.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    id: Int key
    d: meter mutable

rule r:
    R s where min(s.d, 3) > 1_meter
->
    log info "x"
